comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This is used to craft three items:

Statue of Ariadne (x1 M.Gold + R10 Casting; also requires a specific recipe in the Labyrinth's hidden passage)
Minotaur's Axe (x10 M.Gold + R15 Casting; same room as above)
Orichalcum (Transmutation Alchemy equipment + R5 Casting/Alchemy skills; I'm afraid don't know the rest of the required ingredients for Maris server, though)

There are two possible ways to obtain this item.

1. Defeat the Minotaur in the Labyrinth endless dungeon, either on every 10th section floor, or in certain hidden passages where it is engulfed in a black aura. The treasure chest in its room will yield a small amount of M.Gold; use of a Statue of Ariadne item will increase its drop rate for a set period of time.
2. Complete a Secret Edict quest for your nation after building the Solar Barge to reach Atlantis, and open a Secret Edict Award item; M.Gold has a chance to drop from it.

Of the two methods, the latter is easier, since the Minotaur is notoriously difficult to encounter, compared to farming Edict rewards from certain Edict quests (as an example: start in Athens from the Guild GM of your choice, talk to a gatekeeper in Candia; return to Athens to report to the GM, pick up the same quest again, and rinse and repeat).

That said, the Edict option is only available when Atlantis is around. It won't always be there. And if it's not... well, hope you enjoy searching for the elusive Minotaur. Cheers.

comments.body: It takes 10 mil check x 5, special purchase bond x 5 and gaseous drug x 5 to make orichalcum through transmutation. With Atlantis surfaced, success rate is 45%. Special purchase bond is cash only. Better get orichalcum directly somehow.
